problem_type: Placement coupled to paid execution and omitted from original editor
symptom: Original storyboard editor has no Place/View action after discard/resplit removal
direct_cause: Existing batch materialization always continues into confirmation and execution
class_root: Placement and execution lack a shared explicit intent boundary
affected_population: Legacy storyboard plans placed from their existing editor
internal_only_reason: Existing storyboard materializer and original editor define placement; no external API changes
invariants: Explicit placement never calls paid confirmation or generation
Repeated placement preserves existing node edits, results and grouping
Async placement remains bound to captured project and canvas lifetime

door_reduction.why_not: Editor selects placement versus generation; the shared row owner performs node materialization.

generality_proof: Both batch intents reuse the same materializer while placement bypasses authorization and preserves bound nodes.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Separate explicit placement from execution with shared materialization and grouping

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Original editor invokes explicit placement and derives View from actual nodes
Existing batch generation retains its confirmation path; explicit placement has zero confirmation

recurrence.reason: Any existing plan can reach the missing action or accidental paid coupling
same_class_scan: Inspected batch generator, row generator, anchor generator and original editor header

prevention.invariant: Placement reuses materialization without executing or rewriting bound nodes
prevention.strategy: Explicit intent at existing shared batch boundary, preserve bound nodes for navigation/repeated placement

legacy_paths.rationale: Existing editor and canvas materializer retained

migration: No data migration or new owner
residual_risks: Controlled regressions do not prove Electron package UI acceptance
